Reference / locale/match

locale/match#

Choosing a locale from what a user asks for (RFC 4647).

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let asked = [BasicLanguageRange("de-CH"), BasicLanguageRange("en")];
LookedUpLocale(requested: asked, available: [Locale("en"), Locale("de")], fallback: Locale("en")).locale();   // de
FilteredLocales(requested: asked, available: supported);     // every match, best first

Description#

Choosing a locale from what a user asks for (RFC 4647).

Lookup drops subtags from the end until something matches, then tries the next range, then the fallback. * matches anything.

object LookedUpLocale#

object LookedUpLocale

RFC 4647 lookup (§3.4) skips '*' and truncates a range, removing a newly dangling singleton too; each truncation must equal an available tag (case aside): a tag is not chosen for a shorter range it extends (#941). Explicit fallback must be in the available set and its first available representative is returned. No likely-subtag or CLDR expansion.

LookedUpLocale.LookedUpLocale#

Looks requested up in available, with fallback; InvalidLocaleSelection when fallback is not available.

locale() is Locale

The locale chosen.
